approach: Fix the order where it starts. In `check_and_verify` (run/mod.rs) delete the up-front `disk_gate`. `free_producer_build` already runs first in the Checks stage. Call the existing `disk_gate` once inside `SnapExec::exec` (run/checks.rs), just before the first check that really executes. `exec` runs only on the local path, so a green or red CI result, a resumed job, a nested run and a fully skipped route never reach the gate. A low reading returns `LowDisk` as an error. It passes up unchanged through `run_local`, `Fallback` and `run_routed_with_record`. `check_and_verify` downcasts it, removes the verify snapshot, and returns the existing `hold_for_disk`. The dispatch, producer and verifier gates are untouched. The drain tests cannot reach a green CI result today. A GitHub origin would hit the real `gh` and a real push, because `ci_seam` and `early_seam` are `cfg(test)` only. So both seams are widened to `cfg(any(test, feature="test-support"))`. `test_support` gets one installer that puts in the existing `EarlyFake` (remote and PR host) and a small fake `gh` Runner. No test touches a network. The verify dir now exists before the new gate, so the "checks have run" signal in the free-space helpers changes from "a verify dir exists" to "the resume mark is at the Verifier stage". One shared parsing helper in `test_support` reads that mark through `StateDir::read_resume`, and all three helpers call it. `crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs` is not touched, and `routing.rs` is not expected to change.

decisions.choice: Gate once inside SnapExec::exec, behind a Cell<bool>, after refuse_if_stopped and before the check seam or run_check. A LowDisk error is turned into hold_for_disk in check_and_verify.
decisions.reason: exec is called only when a check will run locally, which is 'only before a local check run'. No routing or CI-resolution change is needed, and both are out of scope. hold_for_disk needs the owned Closing, which the closure cannot hold, so the error is passed up and downcast. Fallback keeps the original error (routing.rs 290-293) and run_local uses `?`, so the type survives.

rejected.option: Keep one gate in check_and_verify, moved after free_producer_build and before with_ci_source
rejected.why: It still gates before a green CI result is read, so a CI-supplied result could trigger a hold. That misses the request.

rejected.option: Add a gate hook parameter to routing::run_routed_with_record
rejected.why: It changes a routing signature and all its callers, and the brief says not to change routing rules.

decisions.choice: Widen early_seam (gh/mod.rs, gh/early.rs) and ci_seam (run/mod.rs) to cfg(any(test, feature="test-support")). With no seam set, the CI source stays NoCi under cfg(test) and the real GhCli otherwise. Add one test_support installer that sets both seams, using the existing EarlyFake and a new fake gh Runner.
decisions.reason: The critic found that the integration crate builds athena-core without cfg(test). A GitHub origin would then push to github.com through GitRemote, call the real gh in early_pr_to (gh/early.rs:447), and delete a real branch at close. Both seams are per-thread, and the drain tests call athena.go on the test thread. The fakes sit only at the transport edge (Remote, PrHost, gh Runner). Routing, resolve, the gate and hold_for_disk stay production code. gh/mod.rs and gh/early.rs are therefore extra files beyond the brief's deliverables. They are not governance files, and the reason is the external-service risk.

rejected.option: Give the test repo an https://github.com origin and rely on a git insteadOf redirect
rejected.why: No insteadOf exists in the repo, and early_pr and gh would still reach the network.

rejected.option: A fake gh program on PATH
rejected.why: It mutates the process environment across parallel tests and depends on the host.

rejected.option: Test CI reuse only in run/tests.rs
rejected.why: Criterion 2 names drain.rs and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`.

decisions.choice: The 'checks have run' signal in the free-space helpers becomes `test_support::verifier_stage_reached(state: &Path) -> bool`. It builds a StateDir from the root, reads `kept/*` job ids, calls `StateDir::read_resume`, and tests `mark.stage == ResumeStage::Verifier`. The helpers in test_support.rs, drain.rs and binary.rs all call it.
decisions.reason: The verify snapshot is now made before the new gate, so keying on the verify dir would hold at the local-run gate and break the verifier-gate tests. The Verifier mark is written only after every check passed (mod.rs 1577-1580), just before the verifier gate. The critic noted that substring-matching resume.json is fragile, because the candidate and criteria text are free text. Deserializing through ResumeMark avoids that. The helper reads `kept/` and takes no new argument, so scope_guard.rs's use of test_support::low_once_verifying keeps working unchanged.

rejected.why: Free text in the mark can contain the word.

rejected.option: Make the verify snapshot after the gate
rejected.why: SnapExec borrows the snapshot, and the CI read comes first. Verifier-stage logic would also change.

decisions.choice: Use two companion cases for the local-run hold, both with a three-check configuration (fmt, clippy, test) so the route has reuse=true and goes through resolve and Fallback: (b1) no origin, no seam needed; (b2) GitHub origin with the fake gh answering 'no run'.
decisions.reason: This exercises the path that matters: resolve falls back to local checks, and the gate sits there. (b1) needs no seam, as the critic suggested. (b2) shows that 'no usable CI result' with a GitHub origin also holds.

rejected.option: Reuse the default two-check drain fixture
rejected.why: Without a clippy check, covers_all is false and reuse is off, so resolve and Fallback are never reached.

decisions.choice: Leave disk.rs to a doc-comment change only, and do not touch routing.rs. Do not touch scope_guard.rs.
decisions.reason: The gate code is unchanged and routing needs no new behavior. scope_guard.rs is not in the brief. Its test uses test_support::low_once_verifying, whose observable behavior (low once the verifier stage is reached) is kept.

rejected.option: Edit scope_guard.rs to match the new helper
rejected.why: It is outside the deliverables; if its test fails anyway, report it rather than edit.

risks.risk: The verify snapshot, the CI-branch push and the early PR now happen before the local-run gate, so a hold there leaves state behind.
risks.mitigation: Remove verify_dir on the hold path, with the same remove_tree used for the timeout stop. Assert in the (b) tests that it is gone. The CI branch is deleted when the job closes, as it is for any held job today. A resumed job redoes the snapshot as any Checks-stage resume does.

risks.risk: Existing tests that use 'a verify dir exists' as the 'checks have run' signal now hold at the new gate. The probe test in run/tests.rs also assumed a gate while the build still exists.
risks.mitigation: Change the shared signal to the Verifier-stage resume mark in test_support, drain.rs and binary.rs. Update the probe assertions. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain --test binary` and `cargo test -p athena-core`. If scope_guard.rs's test fails, report it instead of editing the file.

risks.risk: Widening ci_seam and early_seam to a feature changes which code is compiled for athena-cli's tests, and dead-code or unreachable-code lints could fire under -D warnings.
risks.mitigation: With no seam installed, behavior outside cfg(test) is unchanged (real runner, real remote). The athena-cli dev-dependency enables the feature, and `athena-core` tests still use cfg(test). Run clippy with --all-targets --locked and fix lints in the final checks.

risks.risk: A test could still reach a real network if an origin is added without the seams installed.
risks.mitigation: Only the (a) and (b2) tests add a GitHub origin, and the installer guard is held for the whole `go`. The test fails if the fake gh Runner was never asked (like `ci_reuse_run` in run/tests.rs). (b1) has no origin.

risks.risk: Space drops during the checks after the first-exec gate passes.
risks.mitigation: The gate covers the first exec only, as the brief says ('just before a local check run'). The old up-front gate did not cover this either.

risks.risk: The green-CI route needs the capability's checks to include fmt, clippy and test (covers_all), which the default drain fixture does not.
risks.mitigation: The (a) and (b) tests use `config_with_change_checks` with all three names. A missing name would show up as reuse=false and the test would fail visibly on the `ci         checks reused` assertion.

demonstrations.method: New test `low_disk_from_the_writer_build_is_cleared_before_the_checks_gate_so_the_job_is_not_held`. Fixture is `disk_fixture()` (min_free_gb 10), built through `go_with_disk`-style wiring. The scripted Producer closure plants `<state>/repo/jobs/<spec.job>/target/produce/debug/big`, as `counting` does in run/tests.rs. The free-space reader is the existing `athena_core::test_support::low_once_built`, installed with `with_free_space`: it reports 3 GB while any `jobs/*/target/produce` exists and plenty otherwise. The test calls `athena.go(job, AcceptedBy::User, &lines)`.
demonstrations.observes: The result is `GoResult::Finished`, not a LowDisk Err. `jobs/<id>/target/produce` is gone. The lines contain `disk       removed the producer's build directory` before the `checks     ` line. No line starts with `held       `.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the old order, the up-front disk_gate runs while `target/produce` still exists, so it reads 3 GB and holds the job. `go` returns Err(LowDisk) and no `checks     ` line is printed, so the test fails.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: `Athena::go`. Fake: `StateDir::with_free_space(test_support::low_once_built)` plus the scripted Producer closure that plants the build directory. The free-space function only reads the filesystem and holds no gate logic. Both exist today (drain.rs `go_with_disk`, test_support.rs 706). The test itself is added in step 7.

demonstrations.method: Three new tests, all using `Fixture::with_config(with_min_free_gb(&config_with_change_checks(fmt, clippy, test), 10))`. The `fmt`, `clippy` and `test` checks are trivial `sh -c` commands, so `route.reuse` is true. Free space comes from a drain.rs reader that returns 3 GB while any `target/produce` exists, or while a `verify` dir exists and `test_support::verifier_stage_reached` is false. Otherwise it returns plenty. So space is low through the writer build and the checks stage, then recovers. (a) `low_disk_with_a_green_ci_run_does_not_hold_the_checks_stage`: `git remote add origin https://github.com/owner/repo`. The new `test_support` installer puts in `EarlyFake` (remote and PR host) and a fake gh Runner that answers a green run for the candidate sha and green jobs. It uses the reply shape of `CiReplies` in run/tests.rs 2446-2530. The test calls `athena.go`. (b1) `low_disk_with_no_ci_result_holds_before_the_local_run`: no origin, so NoCi. (b2) `low_disk_with_a_github_origin_and_no_ci_run_holds_before_the_local_run`: origin, with the fake gh answering `workflow_runs: []`.
demonstrations.observes: (a) `go` returns Finished with no LowDisk error. A line starts `ci         checks reused from` and a line starts `checks     `. No `held       ` line. The EarlyFake recorded a CI-branch push and nothing touched a network. (b1) and (b2) `go` returns Err downcastable to LowDisk (3 GB free, 10 GB required). No `checks     ` line. `read_hold` is Some. The job is Dispatched with no outcome. `jobs/<id>/verify` is gone. After the reader is made plentiful, `athena.retry` plus `go` reach the checks and land, as in the existing `low_disk_before_the_checks_holds_the_job_and_a_retry_with_space_runs_the_checks`.
demonstrations.fails_without: (a) With the gate before the CI read, the writer build still exists at the old gate, so the job is held (LowDisk Err) and the `ci         checks reused` line never prints. (b) If the gate were dropped from the local path, the checks would run at 3 GB, `go` would not return LowDisk, and the hold assertions fail.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: `Athena::go`, with `with_ci_source`, `routing::run_routed_with_record`, `SnapExec::exec` and `hold_for_disk` all real. Fakes: `EarlyFake` (exists in test_support.rs 264-444) and a fake gh Runner, both injected by the new `test_support` installer, which sets the widened thread-local seams. Steps 3-5 add the widened seams, the installer, the Runner and `verifier_stage_reached`. The `with_free_space` hook exists today.
